pokedexEntries.go: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

pokedexEntries.si: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

pokedexEntries.cr: As a result of its pursuit of faster, yet more silent flight, a new set of wings grew on its hind legs.

pokedexEntries.ru: If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that CROBAT has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.

pokedexEntries.sa: CROBAT sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound. This POKéMON rests by hanging on a tree branch with its rear legs that serve as wings.

pokedexEntries.fr: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

pokedexEntries.lg: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

pokedexEntries.em: Over the course of evolution, its hind legs turned into wings. By alternately resting its front and rear wings, it can fly all day without having to stop.

pokedexEntries.di: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

pokedexEntries.prl: A Pokémon that gained vastly enhanced flying performance by having its legs turn into wings.

pokedexEntries.pt: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.

pokedexEntries.hg: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

pokedexEntries.ss: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

pokedexEntries.bw: The transformation of its legs into wings made it better at flying, but more clumsy at walking.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

pokedexEntries.x: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

pokedexEntries.y: Having four wings allows it to fly more quickly and quietly so it can sneak up on prey without its noticing.

pokedexEntries.or: If this Pokémon is flying by fluttering only a pair of wings on either the forelegs or hind legs, it’s proof that Crobat has been flying a long distance. It switches the wings it uses if it is tired.

pokedexEntries.as: Crobat sneaks up on its intended prey using wings that barely make a sound. This Pokémon rests by hanging on a tree branch with its rear legs that serve as wings.

pokedexEntries.su: Both its legs became wings, and as a result, it can’t move well on the ground. All it can do is crawl around.

pokedexEntries.mo: Silent and swift in its four-winged flight, it bites down on its prey before they realize what’s happening. In a heartbeat, it drains their blood.

pokedexEntries.us: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won’t notice any pain or realize you’ve been bitten.

pokedexEntries.um: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

pokedexEntries.sw: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target’s neck.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.

pokedexEntries.bd: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

pokedexEntries.shp: This Pokémon gained vastly enhanced flying capabilities after its legs became wings.

pokedexEntries.la: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.
